release_notes:
## Generals Mobile v124

### Major changes
- Synced the Android/rendering/performance improvements from MYSOREZ v1.2.0 while preserving Generals Mobile-specific controls, audio fixes and the Adreno allocation workaround.
- Added selectable Vulkan/DXVK, native GLES3 and GLES3 via ANGLE rendering. Vulkan remains the default.
- Added a separate secondary mod-folder launcher. Mod loose files and mod BIG archives can override matching base-game assets without copying over or modifying the base installation.
- Added stale-overlay protection so Setup -> Launch Game always starts the base game even if Android reuses a process that previously launched a mod.
- Added graphics/performance fixes including shadow LOD and rendering optimizations.
- Improved game-folder integrity diagnostics and GeneralsOnline session/error handling.
- CI now strips non-DXVK native debug symbols, substantially reducing APK size.

### Validation
Build Android APK run #8 completed successfully on source commit 06415a8054887feadb34beaa9a273b0d54b75feb, including the native build, artifact verification, APK packaging and DT_NEEDED library verification. Physical-device testing of the new mod-overlay path is still recommended for individual mods.

The APK contains engine code only. You must provide game data from a legally owned copy of Command & Conquer: Generals - Zero Hour.
